info.title: vela-plugin - VelaShell plugin developer tool
info.description: VelaShell 插件开发命令行工具(vela-plugin):校验清单、打 .vpx 包、生成签名密钥并签名/验签、把插件工程输出挂进本机 VelaShell 做开发调试。

options.name: --version
options.description: Version to install (same as <id>@<version>)

options.name: --pre
options.description: Consider pre-release versions (default: stable only)

options.name: --source
options.description: Marketplace base URL (env VELA_PLUGIN_MARKET)

options.name: --prefix
options.description: Install root (default: ~/.velashell/plugins)

options.name: --trust
options.description: Require this publisher fingerprint (SHA256:...)

options.name: --allow-unsigned
options.description: Install a package that carries no signature

options.name: --force
options.description: Reinstall even if that version is already installed

options.name: --no-cache
options.description: Ignore the download cache

options.name: --download-only
options.description:
Fetch and verify the .vpx, do not install
uninstall <id>        Remove an installed plugin directory
update [<id>]         Install newer marketplace versions of installed plugins

options.name: --check
options.description:
Only report what is outdated
--pre / --source / --prefix / --trust / --allow-unsigned

options.name: --output
options.description:
Output path (default: <id>-<version>.vpx next to <dir>)
Key file path (default: velashell-plugin-key.pem)
Plugin build output directory (default: newest under bin/)

options.name: --key
options.description:
Sign with this PEM private key
Base64 public key that the signature must match
PEM private key (required)

options.name: --no-mask
options.description: Store the zip payload unmasked (diagnostics only)

options.name: --host
options.description: Pick a registered installation by version or exe path

options.name: --exe
options.description: Use this VelaShell executable instead of a registered one

options.name: --data-root
options.description: Data root for the debug instance (default: ~/.velashell-dev)

options.name: --no-wait-debugger
options.description: Do not pass --wait-debugger (isolated plugins only)

options.name: --watch
options.description: Also pass --dev-watch (auto-reload on rebuild)

options.name: --profile
options.description: Launch profile name (default: VelaShell)

options.name: --link
options.description: Also register the directory in plugins.dev.txt

options.name: --wait
options.description: Wait for the host to exit and return its exit code

options.name: --all
options.description: Include installations whose executable is gone

commands.name: link
commands.description: Register a plugin output directory for development

commands.name: list
commands.description: Show registered development roots and their state

commands.name: prune
commands.description: Drop development roots that no longer exist

commands.name: run
commands.description: Start the host with this plugin mounted (no IDE needed)

commands.name: unlink
commands.description: Remove such a registration
